replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, sometimes I feel overwhelmed by math concepts. The pressure to perform well makes me worry about making mistakes. However, I try to manage this anxiety by focusing on subjects I find more engaging and enjoyable.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I have used AI tools occasionally for homework help. The experience was mixed; sometimes it provided clear explanations, but other times the answers were too technical or didn't match my understanding level.
